title: WhyInitFailure
description: Diagnosis of an init-container failure. Emits a single JSON object with the detected reason and actionable evidence.

init_container.description: Name of the failing init container

init_index.description: Index of the failing init container (0-based)

reason.description: Detected root cause of the init container failure

exit_code.description: Last exit code of the init container

last_log_line.description: Last log line (or the line that matched a signal)

memory_limit.description: Memory limit from pod spec (for OOM diagnosis)

apiserver_error.description: Error message from the apiserver (for config/image issues)

stuck_for.description: Duration the init container has been stuck (for pending diagnosis)

suggested_fix.description: Human-readable suggestion for resolving the issue
